thread:
incident-bot: PAGERDUTY: high-latency-slo-breach eu-west-1 router-p99 > 2.5s (alerting)

oncall-sam: I'm on it — joining bridge now. paging team.

maria-sre: seeing p95 ~800ms but p99 spike to 2.7-3.2s for streaming requests. short tails on text-gen too.

joel-routing: routing telemetry shows a sudden increase in misrouted sessions to shard-eu-03 between 01:12-01:20 UTC. weight skewed to eu-03.

eng-lead-alia: how widespread? customer impact? any errors or just slow?

tessa-pm: CS flagged a paying customer experiencing stalls on live chat integrations — messages fail to stream.

customer-ops-liz: confirmed: 3 customers reported partial streaming stalls, reconnects required. one is on dedicated capacity.

infra-nikhil: infra graphs: node cpu/gpu fine, but ingress-lb queue depth for eu-03 at 1800 reqs, other zones ~200-300. hotspots.

maria-sre: stack traces show long tail during router->backend handoff; backlog at lb proxy. no OOMs.

joel-routing: pulled router routing-policy audit — a rollout from 00:50 UTC adjusted bucket weights; eu-03 got extra affinity due to a misapplied rollout rule. looks like policy bug: weight scale applied twice.

oncall-sam: can we revert the rollout? fast rollback to previous policy config?

joel-routing: yes. I'm preparing a rollback patch. patch id: rb-20260315-1.

ops-bot: Deploy started: rb-20260315-1 -> routing-config-service (eu-west-1)

maria-sre: meanwhile, we should open emergency backpressure to avoid tail amplification — throttle new streaming sessions to eu-03 and enable eager fallback to eu-01/eu-02.

eng-lead-alia: agree. Joel, can you set a temporary routing override route to shift 60% of inbound to eu-01?

joel-routing: applying override now. CLI: ```
redwoodctl routing override --region eu-west-1 --target-shift eu-01=60,eu-02=40 --ttl 600
```

ops-bot: Override applied: shift 60/40 -> eu-01/eu-02 (TTL 600s)

oncall-sam: rollback patch finished?

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: rb-20260315-1 completed in 32s.

maria-sre: early telemetry: p99 down from 3.2s -> 1.9s after override + rollback. p95 stable. streaming stalls reduced but still seeing replays for sessions already stuck.

customer-ops-liz: notified affected customers: initial message sent. letting them know we rolled back policy and are monitoring.

tessa-pm: any retention of logs we should forward to customer for postmortem?

maria-sre: capture request ids for impacted sessions: query: ```
select req_id from router.events where region='eu-west-1' and ts between '2026-03-15T01:10:00Z' and '2026-03-15T01:25:00Z' and latency>1500
```  sending exports to s3/incidents/2839000123/requests.csv

infra-nikhil: running a deeper check: LB kernel shows connection handoff rate spike leading to epoll wake latency. Possibly kernel-level scheduling interacting with our proxy on that host pool.

joel-routing: interesting — the policy misweighting amplified a hot-partition: many sessions mapped to same shard-eu-03 leading to queueing at the lb proxy which then backpressured routers.

eng-lead-alia: next steps: 1) postmortem draft, 2) fix rollout validation to detect double-apply weight anomalies, 3) add e2e canary traffic test for routing overrides, 4) kernel config audit for lb hosts.

oncall-sam: agree. I'll keep the channel open for 30m for followups then hand to postmortem. tagging @tessa-pm and @joel-routing for followup items.

joel-routing: I will open a tracking issue: RDW-2584 "routing rollout double-apply weight bug" and attach rollback and logs.

maria-sre: adding monitoring alerts to detect queue depth asymmetry: if any shard queue > 5x cluster median for 2m -> page SRE.

customer-ops-liz: customers acknowledged update, some still want SLA credit assessment. please include timeline & mitigation steps in customer postmortem.

tessa-pm: noted. will coordinate external comms + internal postmortem.

ops-bot: Incident: RESOLVED (alert cleared) — eu-west-1 latency SLOs returning to normal.

oncall-sam: closing live mitigation. Postmortem owners: joel-routing (root cause & policy fix), maria-sre (mitigation & monitoring), tessa-pm (customer comms).

eng-lead-alia: quick retrospective: adding one-off checklist for routing rollouts next sprint. Also schedule kernel audit with infra-nikhil.

maria-sre: attaching key snippets & graphs to the issue: p95/p99 graphs, router logs, LB queue heatmap.

oncall-sam: thanks everyone — great quick coordination. :thumbsup:

joe-routing (later note): found an unrelated minor config — standalone test harness applied the scale twice when feature flag was enabled. patch in review to harden the CLI.

maria-sre: leaving followups in RDW-2584 and incident board. switching channel to #postmortems for writeup.

ops-bot: Audit export saved to s3/incidents/2839000123/ and cloudwatch-logs archived.

oncall-sam: handoff complete.
